mechanism: Cobicistat is a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase valproic acid levels through inhibition of metabolism, while valproic acid may induce glucuronidation pathways affecting cobicistat levels, creating bidirectional interaction complexity.
action: Monitor valproic acid levels closely; consider therapeutic drug monitoring and assess for signs of valproic acid toxicity (tremor, sedation, hepatotoxicity); evaluate alternative anticonvulsants if feasible.
